versionHistory.title: Document versions and alternatives
versionHistory.description: Save the current draft as an immutable version or start an alternative from the same version. This history is independent of autosave.

versionHistory.exportDescription: History Archive v2 includes every saved version, parent relationship, alternative, and historical Asset. Snapshot v1 contains only the current saved version. Markdown and TXT use the current autosaved draft.

exportStatus.fidelity: Started downloading a file with conversion limits

compareStatus.error: The versions could not be compared

conversationImport.title: Turn AI conversations into records you can continue.
conversationImport.description: Inspect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or KOMYAKU Generic JSON on this device. Review conversation counts, the source hash, and recovery limitations before anything is sent.
conversationImport.empty: Choose JSON exported by a provider to inspect its structure without uploading it.
conversationImport.reading: Validating the source on this device…
conversationImport.errorTitle: This export could not be reviewed

errors.file_too_large: The file exceeds the 10 MiB review limit.
errors.invalid_export: This is not valid supported JSON. Check the selected format as well.

conversationImport.cloudPending: Cloud storage becomes available after connecting an authenticated workspace.

conversationImport.rememberSession: Save the session in this device's OS secure storage

cloudErrors.forbidden: You cannot save conversations to this workspace.

cloudErrors.request_failed: The Cloud operation could not be completed.
